item.title: J&K, Ladakh have entered 'a decisive new chapter': PM Modi on Article 370 anniversary
item.summary: Prime Minister Modi marked seven years since the abrogation of Articles 370 and 35A. This move ushered in a new chapter for Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. The region has seen wide-ranging transformation and expanded opportunities for its citizens. Constitutional rights have been ensured for all, empowering previously marginalized communities. The government reaffirms its commitment to the progress of these regions.
